subject: Demo coverage — DST mismatch week (US/EU/APAC) — proposal and ask
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aileen Park <aileen.park@nimbus.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@apacbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Demo coverage — DST mismatch week (US/EU/APAC) — proposal and ask

Hi Aileen / Tom —

Quick heads up as we lock the demo for Nimbus: the US switched to DST last week (clocks forward), while many EU/APAC teams are still on standard time this week. That creates a one-hour offset mismatch between some of our usual overlapping windows.

We want to avoid the usual ping-pong on invites and make sure both your EU PMs and APAC ops can attend without 6am / late-night slots. Can you confirm who from Nimbus will join (EU lead + APAC reviewer)? I'll propose concrete windows below once I have the attendee list.

Preliminary availability from our side (all times are local for the attendee region; I included equivalent zones):
- Option A: Wed Mar 18, 09:00–09:45 CET (EU) — Diego / Marissa onsite, will stream to US and APAC (equivalent: 03:00 PDT / 11:00 SGT)
- Option B: Wed Mar 18, 11:00–11:45 EDT (US) — Marissa leads demo for US customers (equivalent: 16:00 CET / 02:00 SGT on Thu)
- Option C: Thu Mar 19, 02:00–02:45 PDT (APAC-friendly) — Grace will cover the APAC run-through, and we'll record

If those look messy, we can do a 30-minute overlapping bridge: EU morning + US late afternoon with a 15-minute handoff and local SME in each region. That is my recommended plan to reduce rebook risk.

Please reply with: 1) attendee list and preferred region (EU/US/APAC), and 2) any hard blackout windows on Mar 18–19. If I don't hear back by EOD tomorrow I'll send a conservative calendar with the bridge option and a separate recorded APAC session.

Thanks —
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: regional-availability-2026-03.xlsx (spreadsheet with our suggested windows)
From: Aileen Park <aileen.park@nimbus.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nimbus Scheduling <scheduling@nimbus.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 20:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo coverage — DST mismatch week (US/EU/APAC) — proposal and ask

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the context — good catch on the DST window. Our core attendees for the demo: Claudia Meyer (EU PM), Faisal Ahmed (APAC ops), and I will join from US. Claudia is in Berlin (CET). We have a standing all-hands for the EU product team from 09:00–10:00 CET on Wed, so Option A would conflict for her.

Bridging sounds sensible. Two quick asks before we pick a time:
1) Can you keep the EU-facing portion between 08:00–09:30 CET? Claudia's morning is tight.
2) For APAC, Faisal would prefer anything after 14:00 SGT on Thu (local travel).

If you can propose a single concrete slot that respects those constraints we can confirm quickly. Otherwise we prefer the bridge: EU short overview + recorded deep-dive for APAC.

Aileen Park
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Finance
aileen.park@nimbus.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo coverage — DST mismatch week (US/EU/APAC) — proposal and ask

Thanks Aileen — got it. Proposed concrete plan that minimizes rebook risk and keeps Claudia in the EU morning window:

Plan (one meeting + recorded APAC deep-dive):
- Live session (bridge): Wed Mar 18, 08:30–09:15 CET (Claudia joins for EU morning; Diego leads EU overview). Equivalent: 03:30–04:15 EDT (US) / 11:30–12:15 SGT (APAC) — note APAC attendees will join the tail end for the handoff.
- Recorded APAC deep-dive: Thu Mar 19, 14:30 SGT — Grace will run an hour-long recorded session for Faisal and APAC ops; we'll post the recording and Q&A notes.

Why this helps: 1) keeps Claudia in her preferred window, 2) gives US a workable late-morning (albiet earlier in their zone due to DST), and 3) provides a dedicated APAC recording if live attendance is difficult.

I attached a calendar invite (redwood-demo-20260318.ics) and an updated availability spreadsheet. Marissa / Grace — can you confirm you're ok to cover the EU live and the APAC recording respectively? If so I'll send the invite to Nimbus and lock it.
